principle_text: When the seller provides additional details about the property and asks about the buyer's budget without addressing the price directly, avoid failing to introduce negotiation tactics or leverage to progress towards a lower price.

When the seller confirms limited single-bedroom units in a mostly 3-bedroom inventory, you should leverage this information to negotiate for a lower price, focusing on the smaller studio unit to align with the seller's available options.
When the seller acknowledges the buyer's mention of lower-priced alternatives, you should continue leveraging market comparisons to negotiate a better price.

When the seller offers a price close to the buyer's target range, you should continue negotiating to further lower the final price.
